title: Defining Outbound QC Assignment Records

children: The system uses these records to determine the method of how to assign QC to shipping containers created in the wave. Shipping containers are also evaluated for QC at the time of work unit start, so the system has a chance to assign QC based on who is performing the pick (this is done for containers created in the wave only). On the assignment record, you can define if QC is assigned during the wave and/or at work unit start. You can also indicate how many shipping container(s) you want the system to apply QC to; for instance, 1 out of every 3 shipping containers that are evaluated by this assignment record.
Access the QC Assignment Window, and create a new record.
Use the Name Field to indicate the name of your assignment record.

Use the Assignment Reason Field to represent a description of the assignment method you are defining with this record. This field's value is displayed on both the QC Workbench and the Shipping Container Window's QC tab.

Use the Priority Field to indicate to the system in what order the system should process through the QC assignment records. The record with the lowest priority (that matches the appropriate criteria) will be used by the system to assign QC to the shipment's container.
Use the QC Assignment Criteria Field to indicate the rules that will determine to which containers the system assigns QC.
Use the Container Application Field to indicate to the system how many container(s) using this assignment record will be eligible for QC assignment. For example:
- 1 of 1 containers indicates that the system will assign QC to all shipping containers that meet the assignment filter criteria.
- 1 of 10 containers indicates that the system will assign QC to one out of every ten shipping containers that meet the assignment filter criteria.
Note that 1 of 0 and NULL are invalid values for this field.

Use the Current Container Count Field displays the current count of containers that have matched this QC assignment criteria. The system will increment this count value up by one every time QC evaluation occurs and a matching container is found. Note that this field is never editable by the user.

Suppose you have a new QC assignment record and its container application is defined as 1 of 3 containers. For new records, the current container count begins at 0. When the system evaluates a container using this assignment record, the following occurs:
- For the first container, the system will increment current container count to 1. No QC will be assigned.
- For the second container, the system will increment the current container count to 2. No QC will be assigned.

- For the third container, the system will increment the current container count to 3. QC is assigned to that container, since it is the third container that used this record, which matches the 1 of 3 container application criteria.
- When a fourth container is evaluated using this record, the current container count is incremented to 4, and the pattern continues as described above.
Press OK. The system will save your record.
Using the QC Evaluation Method Tab

Use the QC Evaluation Method Field to determine when the system will evaluate and assign outbound QC to shipping containers. You will have to choose at least one of these options (you can also choose both):
- Wave: The system will evaluate and assign QC to containers created in the wave, if the QC Assignment wave step is in your wave flow, and the QC assignment criteria is met.
- Start Work: The system will evaluate and assign QC to containers at the time of work unit start, if the QC assignment criteria is met.

- Manual: The system will assign QC when a user manually marks a container for QC using the Mark for QC action on the Shipment Insight screen or RF Shipping Container QC screen. Note that only one QC assignment record can be created that uses the "Manual" method of assignment.
